analysis.session_summary: Overnight was a two-speed session: AUD fell sharply on a weak October employment print (actual -43.5K vs forecast 25.5K), while NZD closed at its best and USD firmed after FOMC minutes. The DXY rose 0.122 to 103.797 and USD/JPY gained 0.176%, but AUD/USD lost 0.464% in a 60.7-pip range. Most majors held ranges; EUR/USD chopped within 25.2 pips and closed -11 pips.

themes.evidence: Employment Change printed -43.5K vs 25.5K forecast; AUD/USD fell 0.464%, AUD/NZD fell 0.527%.
NZD +0.179% and closed at best; RBNZ Breman speech produced no quotes.

leg_notes.EUR/USD: EUR/USD had four direction changes within a 25.2-pip range; the FOMC-minutes leg (-7.6 of -13.5) and the Australian jobs leg (+3.4) canceled out, leaving a -11-pip close.

polarity_reads.read: Normal polarity: AUD fell 0.373% on a -43.5K vs 25.5K miss, consistent with no stretched short positioning.
Unscored (no forecast), but USD gained 0.066%; market read minutes as supportive without a quantifiable surprise.

scenarios.name: USD extends on strong US data
scenarios.thesis: Philly Fed above 20.6 and claims below 198K keep USD bid; EUR/USD grinds lower.
scenarios.invalidation: Claims > 200K or Philly Fed < 20.9 breaks USD momentum.

pair_paths.rationale: Recent 25.2-pip range is the immediate envelope; USD-positive data targets the bottom of it.
USD/JPY range was 39.0 pips; strong US data extends the 0.176% advance.

scenarios.name: AUD stabilizes after oversold
scenarios.thesis: After -0.35% AUD decline and AUD/USD -0.464%, short covering emerges if no fresh negative news.
scenarios.invalidation: AUD/USD breaks below 0.66886 close and extends the Employment Change leg.

pair_paths.rationale: Recent 60.7-pip range is the recovery envelope from the jobs miss.
AUD/NZD range 106.3 pips; short covering can retrace the -0.527% jobs drop.

scenarios.name: Risk-off geopolitical flare
scenarios.thesis: Headlines on Iran/China drive haven demand, pressuring AUD and lifting CHF/JPY despite USD strength.
scenarios.invalidation: VIX continues lower from 21.264 and AUD/USD reclaims 0.66886.

pair_paths.rationale: AUD/CHF range 49.8 pips; risk-off extends the -0.364% move.
USD/CHF range 21.2; haven CHF demand pressures the pair.
